title: Add playback controls inside sentence info modal
description: When viewing a line's details in the WordInfoModal, add playback controls so users can practice that specific line without closing the modal. Useful when in Fluid mode but wanting to focus on one line.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Add Play/Pause button for the current line's audio snippet inside WordInfoModal
Add Loop toggle to loop just this line while modal is open
Add speed control (0.5x, 0.75x, 1x) for the line audio
When loop is on, audio repeats until user stops or closes modal
Visual feedback shows when audio is playing/looping
Closing modal stops any looping audio from the modal
